provenance.plan: the plan is frozen at commit ea426c4 (approved specification ed3a2ff), internally frozen and not externally preregistered

code.tree_clean_means: git status --porcelain -- pipeline tests PREANALYSIS.md, run in the gizmo folder, printed nothing (untracked files included), so the commit is the code that ran
code.code_identity_means: git rev-parse --verify HEAD:./<path>, run in the gizmo folder, for pipeline, tests and PREANALYSIS.md: the git tree id of pipeline and of tests and the blob id of the plan at the commit. An id depends only on the content under its path, so with tree_clean true the three ids are the code and the plan that ran, whatever else the repository's commit holds. A resumed run is refused unless all three equal the manifest's (Joe, 2026-11-20, D-122: "Compare code identity"); the commit is recorded and not compared

provenance.outcome_file_hash_in_words: frame_fingerprint of the outcome file as the reader returned it, from the door's record
provenance.assembled_inputs_record_fingerprint_mean: sha256 of the assembler's record converted by the writer's rule, with clock readings left out (_seconds_by_source, assembled_at_utc, read_at_utc, seconds, time_utc, written_at_utc); None when no assembler record was given
provenance.order_enforcement: run_outcomes.run and run_outcomes.run_all are not changed and do not check the order; the coordinator in pipeline/analysis/execute_outcomes.py is where the order is enforced

body.plan_section: Other runs, listed in advance: Callaway and Sant'Anna's estimator with two years of anticipation
body.estimator: callaway_santanna.run (diff-diff 4.0.0, pinned; installed in the gizmo folder's .venv only)
labels: a second estimator of the same quantity

secondary and uncalibrated: a t-based range, the headline plus or minus the t critical value on the number of states less one times the bootstrap standard error of the headline (the module's construction, accepted by Joe on 2026-11-19, D-105); not calibrated by the inference comparison

This run's comparison sample differs from the headline's. On the headline set at 2%, 680 of the 1,670 never-treated units are in no cohort's host region at that cohort's reference year (g-3), and 605 of them are in none of the four host regions (West, ERCOT, SPP, Southeast) at any of the five reference years (counted 2026-11-19 from this module's sample() on quantity files; docs/gate1/callaway-santanna-regions-without-host-2026-11-19.md). The headline's matched comparison utilities come from each host's own region in its reference year. These units stay in this run's sample by Joe's ruling of 2026-11-19 (D-111) and inform the gas-share slope, region entering as a covariate. A difference between this run's estimate and the headline estimate cannot be attributed solely to the estimator.
not applicable: an estimator other than the selected procedure, so no validation is claimed (None is kept for the validated headline alone)
body.needs_before_research_data: RunInputs.cs_sample (CSSampleInputs: host and comparison set-asides, the price hold, the D-34 history). The run needs diff-diff 4.0.0, installed only in the gizmo folder's .venv; under another interpreter it is a failure in words.
